title: Yoisaki Kanade — When The Sound Becomes Clear〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: On This Blank Canvas, I Paint

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We talked before she went off to that art class, but she seemed really unsure about going. That kinda made me worried...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Unsure...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm not sure if it's okay for me to say this right now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Can you tell us more about what you two talked about, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She doesn't think she's good enough...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. She's convinced that you and Mafuyu keep finding new ways to express yourselves while she hasn't.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And she's worried that her illustrations won't be able to do your songs justice...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I had a feeling that she was going through something of a slump, but I didn't realize it was this serious...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
This art class she's attending...
She quit once already, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Which is making it that much harder for her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You need a lot of guts to ask someone to teach you again after leaving them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To make things worse, this teacher's apparently not exactly a ray of sunshine.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, can't she just go somewhere else...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's the thing. This teacher's also a really accomplished artist...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So much so that Ena wants to learn from studying art under them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What's wrong, Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's as if drawing for N25 is what forced her down this terrible path...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, that's...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Not the right way to look at this.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: At the very least, I doubt she'd ever put herself on the line in such a way...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think so too. Ena's all about whether or not she can produce something that's to her liking.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know what you mean.
That's just who she is...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe. Remember when Mafuyu was still making music as OWN here and she said she'd come to SEKAI to give her a piece of her mind?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! I totally froze when she jumped in and screamed, “Just knock it off already!”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you, Mafuyu. You as well, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I understand now that Ena wasn't forced into a corner. She made this choice herself.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Not fully appreciating her situation only served to belittle her.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <In my current state, I feel like I won't be able to draw anything decent for this song or anything that comes after it...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That one sentence encapsulates what Ena's going through right now.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for sharing this information with us, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll be sure to apologize to her later.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay. If she does get mad, I'll be there to take my punishment too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: What do you plan on doing now...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Support her of course.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That won't change.
We'll just have to give her some time to finish her illustration.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I know what she's going through now, so I want to tell her that myself...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also, I want to tell her that we're willing to wait for her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Me too...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll let you guys know if I hear anything more from her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.
